claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if AMD or Anthropic cancels or materially reduces the commitment, or if no first-gigawatt deployment is reported by 2027-07-15. Check quarterly; on trigger, review both parties' latest filings and announcements within 48 hours.
claims.statement: Anthropic and AMD announced a planned deployment of up to 2 GW of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in Helios rack-scale systems; the first 1 GW is expected to begin deployment in the first half of 2027. This is a named alternative accelerator commitment alongside Anthropic's existing NVIDIA supply relationship, but not proof of delivered capacity or revenue.

claims.disproof_condition: Revise when AMD or Anthropic discloses funded tranches, final investment terms, cancellation, or an amount below the announced ceiling. Check quarterly and update within 48 hours of a filing or official announcement.
claims.statement: AMD committed to make a future strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic; the announcement does not establish that the full amount has been funded.

nodes.name: AMD Helios rack-scale solution with Instinct MI450 Series

source_doc.permission_basis: Joint corporate press release distributed publicly; retain only short attributed excerpts needed to verify the announced deployment and investment commitments.
source_doc.title: AMD and Anthropic Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy Up to 2 Gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs

sources.quote: Anthropic to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of MI450 Series GPUs in AMD Helios rack-scale solutions, with deployment of the first gigawatt beginning in the first half of 2027

Anthropic will deploy AMD Helios rack-scale solutions featuring AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs, part of the AMD Instinct MI450 Series, together with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs, AMD Pensando networking and ROCm software.
AMD has committed to make a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic in the future.
Running across a diversified range of hardware lets us map the right workloads to the right hardware.
